records.text: India's moon mission drew 8 million concurrent YouTube viewers.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: This is the highest live concurrent viewers on YouTube. ... Number one was in India. That is a nation of ... They had a moon mission and 8 million people in India tuned into it. That is believable. Okay.

verification.notes: ISRO confirms that the Chandrayaan-3 soft landing was streamed live on YouTube, and contemporaneous reporting records more than 8 million concurrent viewers. This supports the rounded eight-million figure.

records.text: India refused Donald Trump's request to send troops to the Strait of Hormuz and told him to finish the war he started.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Just vibes, some red cows. That's why we're losing, because nobody has a plan. Nobody thought through the Strait of Hormuz, and so he's out there begging everybody to get involved. 'Oh, I picked a fight, and actually I don't really like to fight. I like to get my hands dirty. I don't even touch my own door handles. Can somebody else go fight, beat up Iran for me?' And so now he's looking at India, and he went over there like, 'Hey, can you guys send some troops to the Strait of Hormuz?' ... We've got to keep that open. And India came back and said, sorry, buddy, we're not getting involved. ... So we can add them to our ever-growing list of countries who are telling Trump (Donald Trump), you started it, you can finish it.

verification.notes: Trump publicly demanded that oil-dependent countries provide warships to help secure the Strait of Hormuz, and India said it had held no bilateral talks with the United States about deploying naval vessels. Sources do not support the stronger phrasing that Trump specifically asked India for troops or that India literally told him to finish the war he started.

sources.title: India says no talks with US on warship deployment in Hormuz after Trump's appeal
sources.relevance: Supports India's non-participation while distinguishing warships from troops and denying bilateral talks.

sources.title: Trump says that he's asked about 7 countries to join coalition to police Iran's Strait of Hormuz
sources.relevance: Confirms Trump's general demand for countries to send warships.
